from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        star = operator.Star(worker_llm=self.llm, aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, num_agents=4, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.WORKER_24_PROMPT] * 4, aggregator_prompt=prompt_custom.AGG_24_PROMPT)
        solution = await star(problem)
        response = solution["response"] if solution and solution.get("response") else "```text\ncannot form 24\n```"
        if "cannot form 24" in response.lower():
            swc = operator.StarWithCoordinator(worker_llm=self.llm, coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm, worker_prompts=[prompt_custom.SWC_WORKER_24_PROMPT] * 3, coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.SWC_COORD_24_PROMPT, n_rounds=2)
            retry = await swc(problem)
            response = retry["response"] if retry and retry.get("response") else response
        return response or "```text\ncannot form 24\n```", {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta() or {},
        }

<result>
